meta.description: Introduce lightweight profiling and performance hygiene in Python applications. Use when latency or throughput issues appear.

copy.tagline: 快速定位并优化 Python 应用性能瓶颈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 Python 应用出现延迟或吞吐量问题，需要系统化性能分析。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly identify and optimize Python application performance bottlenecks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your Python app has latency or throughput issues and you need systematic profiling.

howto.what: Claude 会分析 Python 代码性能，生成性能分析计划、瓶颈报告和优化规则，并确保在修改前捕获基线指标。
howto.when: 当用户提到延迟或吞吐量问题，或要求进行性能分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这段 Python 代码的性能瓶颈。
为我的 Flask 应用建立性能基线。
say.note: Claude 会捕获关键路径的基线指标。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes Python code performance, produces a profiling plan (cProfile and/or py-spy), a bottleneck report, and optimization guardrails, and captures baseline metrics before changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users mention latency or throughput issues, or request performance analysis.

say_en.text: Help me analyze the performance bottlenecks in this Python code.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a profiling plan using cProfile or py-spy.

say_en.text: Establish a performance baseline for my Flask application.
say_en.note: Claude will capture baseline metrics for critical paths.
